svg.text: Type Errors Are Empty Sockets (Too Small) or Spilled Pins (Too Large)
Testing candidate values g against the socket specification CD(12, 8) = {1, 2, 4}
Two Halves of the Refinement Predicate on the Value Line g ∈ ℕ:
• No spilled pins (Div(g) ⊆ CD(a,b)) ⇔ g divides both a and b. • No empty sockets (CD(a,b) ⊆ Div(g)) ⇔ every common divisor divides g.
